core_changes: Content.from_realtime_event(kind=...) and a 'realtime_event' ContentType: Content's constructor accepts the unknown type at runtime, but ContentType and Content.from_dict's type check (_types.py:2047) reject it, so a serialised update with realtime-event content wouldn't round-trip.

FunctionInvocationContext.realtime_conversation: set by an internal function middleware the conversation always installs, because _auto_invoke_function builds the context itself and only passes a context to tools without middleware when the tool declares a ctx parameter.

Content.from_text(status=): Content() already takes status, and text merges keep the latest status (_types.py:2142), so only the factory keyword is missing. The prototype calls Content('text', status=...).
